title: Manually reviewed HarborLens aggregate release approval
description: Cryptographically signed, reviewer-pinned SHA-256 and purpose assertions; not proof of upstream data rights. The Ed25519 message is the domain separator line harborlens.publication-review.v1, a newline, then the canonical JSON of every field except signature_b64 (sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII escaping, non-finite numbers rejected, trailing newline). A signature that omits that separator is invalid.

reviewed_at_utc.description: ASCII YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with no fraction or 1 to 6 fractional digits, then Z. The parser builds the clock from those fields and does not call fromisoformat, so Python 3.10 and 3.12 agree. +00:00, any other offset, a lowercase t or z, a space separator, a comma fraction, 7 or more fractional digits, a non-ASCII digit, hour 24, and a date-only value are rejected. Accepted only when not older than 30 days and not more than 5 minutes ahead of the checker clock. The 5 minutes are a fixed clock-skew allowance, not a configuration knob.
